snippet.title: Weeny Wise | 10 Minute Alpha Gameplay Footage
snippet.description:
We’re hard at work on Weeny Wise, and while we’re still in the alpha stage of development, we’re excited to give you a sneak peek with this 10-minute footage. Please note, this is just a glimpse from the early stages of the game, and it doesn’t represent the final quality! 

We can’t wait to share more exciting news with you soon. Thank you for your continued support as we keep improving and bringing this project to life!

If you're a fan of 2-player co-op games, you can add Weeny Wise to your Steam wishlist right now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2820270/Weeny_Wise/?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=YouTube&utm_campaign=YouTube
